description: Use this when the user wants a CSV file, for example "put this table in a CSV", "make a spreadsheet file from these rows", "export this list as CSV for Excel". Pass columns (header names) and rows (each row has one cell per column; cells are text, numbers, true or false, or null), up to 2,000 rows and 100 columns. Optional: filename, excel_bom (start the file with a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads accents) and escape_formulas (show cells starting with = + - or @ as text). Returns the CSV text, a download link that works for 24 hours, its expiry and the row count. It makes a file only; it does not open or edit spreadsheets.

escape_formulas.description: Prefix text cells that start with = + - or @ with an apostrophe so a spreadsheet shows them as text. Default false.

excel_bom.description: Start the file with a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel opens accents correctly. Default false.

filename.description: File name, letters and digits; .csv is added.

rows.description: Up to 2000 rows; each row has one cell per column.

name: make_csv_file

download_url.description: Link that works for 24 hours, or null when no link could be made.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (ISO 8601 UTC).

message.description: What to fix in the input when status is invalid.

title: Make a CSV file
